finalText: Root cause: `orderTotal` in `src\pricing.js` was applying tax to the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount (the function's own doc comment said otherwise). Changed it to tax the discounted total via `applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`. The suite now reports 625/625 passing, and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (spec/runner untouched, engine rules correct).
